content: Zendesk does NOT natively tint ticket rows by priority, confirmed by Zendesk staff and still unshipped in 2026. Zendesk employee Nicole17 (2019-04-03): 'Unfortunately there's not a CSS type of thing you can change.' PM Mo51 (2024-03): 'Color coding tickets is something we're looking into but I don't have any timelines.' PM Salvador Vazquez (2024-03) logged it as backlog 'future consideration'. Feature requests open since Feb 2021 (11 upvotes), Aug 2021 (8 upvotes), May 2025 (4 upvotes), still active July 2026. What Zendesk DOES give free: (1) a small coloured status icon preceding each row (status only, not priority); (2) SLA / Group SLA column badges coloured green >15min, amber <15min, red = breached, but badge-level not row-level and only on Professional+ plans with an SLA policy configured; (3) view column configuration so an admin can add a Priority column; (4) view-level Group by and Order by priority; (5) agent-side Filter button and column-header sort, filters persist until sign-out, available on all Suite/Support plans; (6) custom fields + triggers as a DIY visual-indicator column. Critically, Zendesk Apps Framework v2 sandboxes marketplace apps in iframes with NO host DOM access, so no Marketplace app can tint the native ticket list - the only ways are a browser extension or a userstyle. Competitor context: Freshdesk ships row colour-coding natively.
